title: Acceptance Testing — Overview
summary: Customer validation that the system meets business needs and is fit for use.
body:
Customer validation that the system meets business needs and is fit for use. Standard final test level.

Approaches commonly used alongside it include UAT, Alpha/Beta Testing, Sign-Off.
